page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.1-16 is a virtual machine configuration configured with 1 physical core and 2 vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at a base clock of 2.7 GHz. The system provides dedicated CPU resource allocation alongside 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding an elevated memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, backed by instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AVX-VNNI, and hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions like AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance contrasted with limited parallel capacity due to the low thread count. The server ranks in the top tier for single-core tasks, recording a Geekbench single-core score of 2565.0, a stress-ng single-core score of 3429.07, and strong single-threaded data compression rates. Conversely, aggregate multithreaded output is bounded by the dual-thread allotment, yielding lower tier marks in PassMark CPU, software compilation, and multi-core Geekbench metrics. Large-block memory throughput reaches 46.58 GB/sec for uncached reads and 32.97 GB/sec for uncached writes, sitting in the middle tier.

This instance includes no local NVMe storage and relies entirely on external network block storage for persistence, accompanied by one complimentary public IPv4 address and no GPU accelerators. The hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy or execution paths limited to a single thread, where running larger instances would leave compute capacity underutilized. It trades away multi-tenant scale and heavy parallel processing throughput in favor of a low entry resource footprint with ample per-core RAM.

VM.Standard.E6.Flex.1-16 is suited for memory-sensitive single-threaded services, small in-memory caching layers, text processing services, lightweight API middleware, and entry-level background queue workers that do not demand extensive parallel execution.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.1-16 is an x86_64 compute instance featuring 1 dedicated AMD EPYC 9J45 physical core (2 vCPUs) clocked at 2.7 GHz and paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks integrated local disks and GPU hardware, relying on external network storage for disk operations while bundling a complimentary public IPv4 address. Benchmarks demonstrate leading single-core performance, evidenced by top-tier single-threaded Geekbench scores, stress-ng execution, and compression throughput. However, its small core footprint restricts aggregate multithreaded capacity across intensive workloads like parallel compilation and dense database operations. With an 8 GB per vCPU memory allocation, this server provides a cost-conscious architecture for single-threaded or small-scale memory-intensive workloads, including lightweight in-memory data structures, static web serving, staging environments, and single-stream queue workers.
